# Pranav Dixit — Code & Cognition

> AI/ML Engineer & Full-Stack Developer specializing in practical systems engineering, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React, and agentic AI systems.

Pranav Dixit is a Computer Science and Engineering student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at UPES, Dehradun (expected graduation: May 2028, CGPA: 8.4/10). His work connects practical backend and full-stack software development with AI, computer vision, data pipelines, and agentic architectures.

## Primary Resource

- [Portfolio](https://pranavdixit-25.github.io/): Canonical personal portfolio containing developer story, professional experience, featured projects, technical skills, achievements, leadership, and contact information.

## Professional Focus

- AI/ML & Agentic Systems: Google Gemini API, agentic AI patterns, LLM retrieval pipelines, intent routing, and model training fundamentals.
- Backend Engineering: Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, and microservice architectures.
- Relational & Document Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLAlchemy ORM, SQLite with BM25 / FTS5 full-text search.
- Frontend & Mobile: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Native, Streamlit dashboards, Plotly data visualizations, and accessible HTML5/CSS3.
- Computer Vision: OpenCV, MediaPipe gesture tracking, Tesseract OCR, real-time desktop interaction, and surveillance analysis.
- CS Foundations: Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Distributed Systems, System Design, and Computer Networks.

## Featured Work

- **SupplyChain AI** — AI-Powered Supply Chain Analytics Assistant. Full-stack operational analytics platform with automated ETL pipelines, normalized PostgreSQL schema, SQL-backed analytics, FastAPI microservices, 7-module Streamlit dashboard, deterministic assistant with intent classification, allowlisted tools, and BM25 / SQLite FTS5 document retrieval.
- **UniSmart LMS** — AI-assisted learning management system prototype with decoupled Admin and Faculty portals, JWT authentication, role-based access control, and generative AI attendance analytics.
- **Hand Gesture Virtual Mouse** — Real-time webcam computer vision interface using Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe to map finger tracking and pinch gestures to OS-level mouse actions.
- **Legal Lens** — SIH (Smart India Hackathon SIH26034) Team Lead. AI consumer compliance and packaged-product inspection platform under Legal Metrology Rules with deterministic rule engine and automated PDF reports.
- **ResQConnect AI** — Emergency response network concept and demo connecting patients, ambulance operators, and hospitals with Gemini-assisted severity triage and dispatch workflows.
- **Vigilant** — Vision-based vehicle access and safety monitoring system with license plate OCR and helmet violation detection.
- **Campus Lost & Found Management System** — Standalone multi-role Java Swing desktop application with layered OOP architecture and JSON persistence.
- **Expense Tracker Mobile App** — Cross-platform mobile budget tracking application built with React Native.
